lead.deck: CENTCOM says five carriers were destroyed after the Guard twice fired on a U.S. warship. Tehran says it hit ten ships near Hormuz and fired on a U.S. base in Jordan; oil passed $100.
lead.headline: U.S. SINKS FIVE IRANIAN TANKERS AS IRAN HITS BACK
lead.map_caption: THE GULF, OVERNIGHT — FIVE TANKERS DESTROYED · TEHRAN CLAIMS 10 SHIPS HIT IN REPLY · OIL PAST $100 · SCHEMATIC, NOT TO SCALE

stories.deck: A seven-stage drone and missile operation dropped the road arch in the war's biggest overnight attack.
stories.headline: Kerch Bridge road span collapses into the sea

stories.deck: More than 1.7 million remain displaced and 1.4 million face acute hunger as flooding worsens the crisis.
stories.headline: U.N. warns of deaths from cold as winter closes in
